task_description: Write an essay in response to the given topic. Give reasons for your answer and include relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
model_answer: [Model answer: Write at least 250 words. Structure: Introduction with clear position, 2-3 body paragraphs each with a main idea + supporting examples, and a conclusion that restates the position.]

scoring_criteria.task_response: Addresses all parts of the question with a clear position throughout
scoring_criteria.coherence_and_cohesion: Clear paragraphing with cohesive devices used appropriately
scoring_criteria.lexical_resource: Wide range of vocabulary with natural collocations
scoring_criteria.grammatical_range_and_accuracy: Complex structures with frequent error-free sentences
